schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to get around when public transport is on strike?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في التنقل عندما يكون النقل العام مضربًا عن العمل؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, unterwegs zu sein, wenn im öffentlichen Verkehr gestreikt wird?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to get around when public transport is on strike?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که وقتی حمل‌ونقل عمومی اعتصاب دارد رفت‌وآمد کنید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de vous déplacer en cas de grève des transports en commun ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy közlekedni, amikor sztrájkol a tömegközlekedés?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a spostarti quando i mezzi pubblici sono in sciopero?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, toplu taşıma grevdeyken ulaşmaktan vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
